answer_1.quote: PropRAG uses Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (AI@Meta, 2024) for offline proposition extraction and as the QA reader...
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are answers to complex multi-hop questions, produced by a QA reader LLM based on retrieved evidence.

answer_2.quote: We report standard metrics: Passage Recall@5 for retrieval quality, and QA F1 score for end-to-end performance, following MuSiQue evaluation scripts.
